description: Machine-readable documentation standards for managed repositories.

requiredRootFiles.name: README.md
requiredRootFiles.recommendedAction: Create a README.md with project description, installation steps, and usage guide.

requiredRootFiles.name: LICENSE
requiredRootFiles.recommendedAction: Add a LICENSE file to clarify terms of use.

requiredRootFiles.name: CONTRIBUTING.md
requiredRootFiles.recommendedAction: Add CONTRIBUTING.md to guide contributors on how to submit changes.

requiredRootFiles.name: CHANGELOG.md
requiredRootFiles.recommendedAction: Add CHANGELOG.md to document notable changes between versions.

readmeStandards.minLengthRecommendedAction: Expand README.md to at least 300 characters with meaningful project information.

recommendedSections.heading: ## Installation
recommendedSections.recommendedAction: Add an Installation section describing how to set up the project.

recommendedSections.heading: ## Usage
recommendedSections.recommendedAction: Add a Usage section showing how to run or use the project.

recommendedSections.heading: ## Contributing
recommendedSections.recommendedAction: Add a Contributing section or reference CONTRIBUTING.md.
